replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
1. Within the community there are quite a few regulars who are suspicious of you and TBH I have to admit I have a suspicion as well, which I will explain later. 

2. I was at the point of asking you to go to your controls, I had asked you three times, now I understand there is a language barrier here and that's fine however after you stopped sharing the screen the call ended, now this is where it gets tricky:

a)  You could hung up on me - unfortunately when screensharing someone and they hang up on you, it doesn't look too good on their part. From my side of the screen it looks like you have something to hide so you disconnected.

b) You say you have bad internet. Hmmm, this could be true and the call could've lagged out. Unfortunately you weren't using a mic so I couldn't tell if you were lagging out (Generally their voice goes all robotic and laggy when their internet is bad)

If you can prove that you timed out of the Skype call, then I guess I have no evidence against you and you will be unbanned.

Forgive this next part if you think I'm calling hacks on you, you could be very well playing legit, however I noticed some similarities between you and someone else I fought a while ago.

I spectated you a bit beforehand and witnessed 2 rather odd combo's you pulled off. If you do have a client, I have an extremely good idea on which one you are using, judging as I have faced a similar client firsthand. Sorry if you aren't hacking, its just it looks like you could be using a client I know very well.

replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
Unfortunately, pictures from moderators on other servers saying you are legit doesn't count for much on Avicus. You might be hacking on their server and they may just not be well trained screensharers.

Just because they say you don't hack on their server, it doesn't mean that you are 100% legit here. You could be legit on one server but use a client on another.

I can see that your internet suffers a fair bit and while I find it a good explanation as to why you lagged out of the screenshare, I am struggling to see how you get the hits you do ingame with really bad and laggy internet. The combo's you manage to pull off with that internet is seeming questionable to me.

Were you recording your screen by any chance while you were being screenshared, as I need proof that you lagged out of that screenshare. I know I am playing a lot of "bad cop" here but unfortunately there are some who use bad internet as an excuse to get out of being caught out in a screenshare.

replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place here:

While I am a bit suspicious of whether you client or not, I am almost 100% sure you are telling the truth. That being said, if I unban you because I believe you that you lagged out, all of a sudden I have to apply that rule to everyone else. Suddenly everyone could "Lag out" of a screenshare and ask me "You believed him, why don't you believe me? I really did lag out. Nathy bias mod! Demote please!"

Unfortunately I cannot bend the rules for one person, I need some evidence from you at the time of the screenshare. If you could possibly get some kind of internet report that showed your internet crashed at that time (I don't even know if they exist, but if they do then I'd consider that proof) or if you were recording during the screenshare?
